messages:
Alex: uh does anyone else see a pigeon by the reception desk or is my metaphorical inbox finally taking physical form? 🐦
Priya: i just walked past and it bowed to the badge scanner. either very polite or it knows how to get to the snack drawer.
Mateo: (posts photo: https://imgur.com/officepigeon) that is 100% a pigeon with an attitude. feeding it crackers now.
Jules: name suggestions: "Sir Pecksalot", "Mailroom Merlin", "Agent Feathers"
Alex: i vote Sir Pecksalot. very dignified.
Priya: lore idea: The Pigeon once demanded a TPS report and left droppings in the binder. very dramatic.
Mateo: small update: pigeon pecked the concession jar lid off, now we have a crunchy alliance.
Jules: new tradition: anyone finishing a big ticket places a tiny paper crown on Sir Pecksalot for 1 hour. rules posted in #random.
Reacji Bot: added :pecksalot: emoji (reaction: :sparkles:)
Alex: poll: crown? tiny cape? honorary badge? (react with :thumbsup: crown, :tada: cape, :heart: badge)
Priya: :thumbsup:
Mateo: :tada: (cape looks fun)
Jules: :heart: (badge would be forever)
Alex: outcome: crown + badge. patchrun of 30 "Official Feathered Fellow" stickers. who wants to help design?
Priya: i will sketch a crest: pigeon silhouette + tiny laurel. minimalist.
Mateo: i will handle production logistics. also learned pigeons love cinnamon crackers, who knew.
Jules: also maybe add a line to office handbook under pets/visitors: "If Sir Pecksalot visits, please do not try to onboard him to the access policy."
Alex: pinned message to #random: "Sir Pecksalot visitation log + sticker plan"
Reacji Bot: pinned message to #random: "Sir Pecksalot lore entry"
Priya: note for onboarding: new hires will be introduced to Sir Pecksalot protocol on day 1. mandatory reverence optional.
Mateo: documented. someone please make a tiny paper crown prototype so we can test fit.
Jules: i will bring craft supplies tomorrow. long live the winged visitor."
